references.text: In this verse, the Jews call Jesus a Samaritan and say he has an evil spirit, which mirrors the accusation that he has a demon in John 10:20.
Here the Jews repeat the accusation that Jesus has an evil spirit and ask why they should listen to him, which is a direct parallel to the reaction in John 10:20.
The crowd says that Jesus has a demon and asks if he is trying to kill them, showing the same suspicion and accusation of possession as in John 10:20.
